editorial.blurb: Ying Dim Sum 88 is an authentically vibrant Chinatown spot where fresh, expertly made dim sum arrives fast and affordable—the kind of place locals return to again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Pro move: bring your own chili oil to elevate the experience, and eat rice noodles fresh right away since they don't travel well.

topDishes.note: Crispy outside, juicy inside—Chicago's best, according to fans
Filling, authentic, and a bargain at around $3
